title: This year is for vampire musicals and saying “yes” @Blood/Love #newmu...
transcript: I spontaneously got my first tattoo last week and I am obsessed. Went to a preview event for the new off Broadway musical Blood/Love, which is starting February 13th. All about vampires. They sang us some of the songs from the show, and they were also offering free flash tattoos. And as somebody who's always wanted one and can never make a decision to save their life, I decided why not? Here's a preview of some of the songs from the show that they performed for us and tattoo reveal at the end. And he turned out so cute. I am obsessed. I'm also really excited for Blood/Love starting February 13th.
classificationReason: Creator attended a pre-opening promotional event (song showcase + tattoo giveaway) before the show's February 13th opening, not the actual staged production. This is anticipation/commentary about an upcoming show, not a first-hand review of the live production.
